correctness.rationale: For S>=2 independent walkers on any fixed connected finite loopless bipartite graph, simultaneous global reset to a split-color configuration with 1<=m<S and reset probability gamma in (0,1), define independently lazy P_eps=(1-eps)P+eps I and a simultaneous target j. Product killed kernel gives exact discounted success p_eps=(1-gamma)e_r^T(I-(1-gamma)Q_eps)^(-1)b_eps. Bipartition parity shows a successful path requires >=k=min(m,S-m) individual holds; explicit same-length paths with exactly k holds yield a strictly positive k-th Taylor coefficient a_j. Analyticity gives p_eps=a_j eps^k+O(eps^(k+1)); exact renewal gives E T=(1-p)/(gamma p), and geometric cycles with uniformly bounded second moments yield scaled Exp(1). For reset hub/leaf in any star, exact 3-state Markov equations yield given rational mean, and the derivative quartic has one positive root by Descartes signs. Independently reconstructed symbolic star resolvent and tested parity powers in small graphs, without using finite tests as infinite proofs.
